subject: squirrel
name: 松鼠
label: 跳跃的松鼠
learning: 先观察主体各部分怎样连接，再挑几处有特点的细节。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. A natural red squirrel leaping sideways with clear separated front and rear feet, sweeping bushy tail, short ear tufts and a small acorn held in front paws.
Strict correction: clean pure contour illustration, NOT an engraving. Smooth empty white body and tail interiors. The squirrel is gracefully leaping while holding a simple acorn, natural joined hind legs and paws, one broad curling tail. Only the silhouette, eye, ear, chest boundary, paws and one tail curve are drawn. Absolutely no hair strokes, fur texture, hatching, gray shading or tonal fills.
